sourceReviewerNotes.note: 3/17/26 AI review: Based on the conversation in the meeting, I think this requirement is fine.

Amendments, deleting and adding new charges.  3/20/26 We have this ability in 3 places. On ADDTRCR when the case is built. On UPDTCJ after the case is added so other charges can be added with this criteria and on the AMEND screen after a hearing.  there may be some parts of this available in Docket, but can't say for sure.  Just want to clarify if this ability will be available in multiple places considering the phases of the case.

3/20:  After our discussion, I believe this requirement is fine as-is.  

My understanding of the required fields in the statute table: effective begin and end dates, offense types (fel,msd,inf), statute descriptions, triggers that indicate if the offense can have a jail term affixed as a judgment, if an abstract needs sent to DMV in a batch report, and to notify DMV if the statute is eligible for a suspended license.  If the statute is a speeding offense, we must track location and where the speeding range is.  Additionally we also collect the AAMVA codes which tell DMV how many points should be taken from the driver record- it would be nice if DMV could update some of these fields themselves.   We also collect the PCH charge from NSP, and collect the statute chapter.  

I believe a lot of judges would like the ability for our CMS to better match the statutes as they are listed by the legislative website. 

We should add a requirement that collection of these items should be set at the state-level and at the county level for court clerks to maintain their county ordinances for city prosecutor charges.
I was thinking about the same as Laurayne on the multiple areas where information is amended and must be recorded to other screens

Our current workflow operates as follows: if a case is filed with incorrect data generally the attorneys  could file an amendment if its something small that can be corrected, or if it's completely wrong, the attorney or court dismiss the case. Core Case Linking / Relationship Management
2.2.16
The system must allow users to link cases regardless of case type, including linking to cases that do not exist within the CMS using a designated reference number field.
2.2.17
The system must allow authorized users to remove case links.
2.2.34
The system must retain linkage history when cases are de-linked, consolidated, or separated, including effective dates and reasons.
Related Case Creation / Association
1.4.8
The system must support initiating related-but-separate cases (e.g., co-defendant/co-minor/co-sibling scenarios) that share selected data elements while remaining distinct cases with independent lifecycle processing.
1.2.11
The system must support grouping related records under a single case with subordinate identifiers while maintaining linkage and traceability.
Cross-Case Data / Behavior
2.1.24
The system must automatically populate a non-criminal case with information from a linked criminal case based on predetermined criteria.
2.1.31
The system must identify and flag conflicting data values across linked cases and provide tools to reconcile discrepancies.
2.05.40
The system must evaluate dependencies across linked or related cases and warn users when an action on one case may impact another.
Coordination vs Consolidation (Important Distinction)
2.2.41
The system must support “coordination” of cases (heard together without transfer of data) distinct from consolidation.
2.2.22
The system must support consolidation of multiple cases into a single case record while maintaining traceability.
2.2.43
The system must support de-consolidation of previously consolidated cases with controlled record movement.
Multi-Case Structures / References
2.2.42
The system must support association of multiple case numbers and formats to a proceeding and support filing under a controlling case number.
Cross-Case Document & Data Behavior
2.3.20
The system must support pre-populating merged documents using information from any linked case.
Notifications / Scheduling Awareness
2.06.12
The system must notify users of co-defendant or related cases during scheduling.
Reporting / Visibility
2.12.06
The system must allow authorized users to view all cases related to an individual, including linked cases, subject to security rules.
Post-Disposition / Non-Case Linking
5.2.67
The system must merge non-case records into a future initiated case while maintaining traceability.
5.2.71
The system must link non-case records to related parties, cases, or events while preserving traceability.
Appeals Linking (Trial ↔ Appellate)
6.2.73
The system must record filing of appeals and associate each appeal with the originating case.
6.2.77
The system must preserve linkage between originating case and all appellate cases, including successive appeals.

stagedRequirements.originalRequirementText: The system must support receiving and tracking wills or estate planning documents lodged with the court prior to a case being filed, including unique identifiers, depositor, receipt/acknowledgment, and linkage to a later case if filed.
stagedRequirements.sourceProcessAlignmentNotes:
Pre-case lodged documents tracking

Can this be deleted? As already covered - or is this specific/different functionality. 

Nicole: Review this holistically, created matter tracking requirement - 1.2.9 - ensure the general requiremetn includes functionality to link these items to cases. 

5/6 Note: This funtionality is unique enough that we should call it out specifically. 

Suggested alt text: The system must support receiving and tracking wills or estate planning documents lodged with the court before a case is filed, including unique identifiers, depositor information, receipt or acknowledgment generation, withdrawal status, and linkage to a later case if filed.

We could remove this - but then make 1.2.9 broader: 

Current 1.2.9: The system must support creation of miscellaneous and administrative tracking matters (non-standard case types), including items such as search warrants, bail instruments pending filing, lodging of wills, and other court-defined tracking records.

Suggested alt: The system must support creation and management of tracking matters, including search warrants, bail instruments pending filing, lodged wills, estate planning documents, pre-filing communications, and other court-defined records. The system must support unique identifiers, searchable indexes, receipt or acknowledgment generation where applicable, withdrawal or completion status, and linkage to a case if one is later filed.

sourceReviewerNotes.note: 4/13/2026 Also need an index for searchable unattached records.

"Estate planning documents?" We have safe keeping for wills, but we don't have estate planning documents otherwise recorded until a case has been opened. We need tracking for wills filed for safe keeping, receipting, and track if will is withdrawn, and be able to attach to a case if one gets filed.

Rule-driven case party and participant data management

It means the system should guide users to enter case, party, and participant information in a consistent way based on configurable business rules and workflow requirements.

For example, the system could require different information depending on:

Case type
Party role
Participant type
Filing type
Workflow stage

stagedRequirements.originalRequirementText: The system must support suspension, modification, and override of time-standard counting under configured conditions, with required reason and audit tracking.
stagedRequirements.sourceProcessAlignmentNotes:
Time-counting suspension and override governance

It means the system should be able to adjust how case time standards are calculated when certain circumstances apply.

For example, the system may normally count how many days a case has been pending or whether a hearing/disposition deadline is approaching. But in some situations, the clock may need to pause, change, or be overridden, such as when:

A case is stayed
A defendant fails to appear
A party is unavailable
A required evaluation is pending
A continuance changes the applicable timeline
A case enters diversion or another alternate workflow
A judge or authorized user approves an exception

The “required reason and audit tracking” part means the system should require the user to document why the time standard was changed and preserve who made the change, when, and what changed.

stagedRequirements.sourceProcessAlignmentNotes:
Single source of truth

Nicole: 
The intent is to avoid duplicate data entry across the CMS when the same data element is already captured and available for reuse.

Suggested alt text: The system must reuse previously entered or received case, party, participant, document, event, and financial data across applicable screens, workflows, documents, reports, and exchanges, based on configured rules, to reduce duplicate data entry.

sourceReviewerNotes.note:
Financial Review: ok

This is very important.

Agree with JH. To RC's comment: in most person-based systems I've seen, there is a "master data index" or something similar where the "official" person data is held. So if it is changed there, then it would change across the board, however if the person data is changed in a specific case, then it would only be changed in that case (and probably any linked cases).  I would be more interested to see this for case data rather than person data.

I also agree with Jordan.  Cross-updating is important.  My question then becomes what happens in a person-based system and can we assume that the cross-updates would only occur within the one case and not update other data elsewhere?  If that data needs to be updated in the other cases, then the clerks should have the ability to update in "batch" with proper authorization and configurations/workflows. > see requirement 2.10.14
Also allow for data to be updated in one place and copy across to all other places the same data element is held.

5/13:  NEJ needs an explanation of the intent of this requirement to ensure our understanding aligns. Can you also provide clarity on what notification means? 

Intent: This requirement is intended to ensure that attorney conflict issues are surfaced to the appropriate users or groups for review and action. 

“Notification” is intended broadly and may include an on-screen alert, prompt, task, work queue item, dashboard item, or internal system message. It is not limited to email or external messaging.

stagedRequirements.sourceProcessAlignmentNotes:
Inter-agency relationship reporting

Suggested alt language: The system must support reporting on court-defined relationships between cases, parties, participants, and external entities, including child protection, probation, law enforcement, treatment providers, and other court-approved agencies, based on relationship information maintained in the CMS or received through configured data exchanges.

Notes: Originated from discussions re: mental health, probate, service provider discussions... general discussion was that the CMS should be able to store/report those relationships when known, whether entered in the CMS or received through an integration.

Consider deletion unless we want/need the system to be able to report the relationship between a case/party/participant and an outside agency or service entity. 

That is different from merely maintaining the agency record or tracking a referral. It answers questions like:

“Show me all cases where probation is involved.”
“Show me all cases connected to a specific child protection agency.”
“Show me all participants connected to a treatment provider.”
“Show me cases where a law enforcement agency, service provider, or court-approved entity has a defined relationship to the case.”

sourceReviewerNotes.note: I think we would need to have more discussion on this. I agree this would be a good thing but the ability to actually connect with the other systems may be limited. We would also need to discuss if it is a one-way or two way connection.

We don't do mental health cases, unless this is for criminal cases and mental health classes are part of probation. 5/12 How does it report and track this information, within a court, within a county, or across the state?

I agree more discussion is needed.  I could see the benefit of having this ability if our CMS expands in the future (ie. G/C database is added on, probation is able to get a partner product to tie in, etc.)

G/C cases have various options, where an interested party can opt out of receiving notices. An option to turn off party document service would be helpful. This may not be the correct place for me to document this.
